card.name: Words inside group and membership phrases
card.fires_on: Small words and nouns inside phrases about members of a group, such as a university, team or committee ("matters of concern", "members of the MIT community", "the only player"). The marked word is usually a link word or a count word.

modes.label: Link words in institutional phrases
modes.description: A linking word or noun in a sentence about the rights or roles of members of an institution.
modes.example: All members of the University have the right to press for action on matters<< of>> concern by any appropriate means.

modes.label: Group and majority terms
modes.description: Words such as only, majority, minority or members describing who counts within a team or body.
modes.example: The goalkeeper is the<< only>> player who is permitted to touch the ball

modes.label: Dates and figures in institutional histories
modes.description: Digits in years or percentages within timelines of an organization.

card.writes: It pushes toward words for staff and internal groups, and away from words for government and citizens.
card.plain: It fires on little words inside sentences about the members or staff of an organization, steering away from government or public wording.
